name: Gross Body Equilibrium
definition: The ability to keep or regain your body balance or stay upright when in an unstable position.

benchmark.name: HumanoidBench
benchmark.metric: episode return on h1-balance-simple-v0 (success threshold 800, random baseline about 9.4), final average at 1M environment steps
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce performing tasks that need whole-body balance, such as construction, warehouse and trades workers. The analogy is standing on a rola-bola-style unstable board after brief practice.

benchmark.name: HumanoidBench
benchmark.metric: episode return (task success threshold = 800; not a percentage)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult workforce in physically active jobs (e.g., construction, warehouse, trades) who routinely keep their balance on unstable surfaces

benchmark.name: HumanoidBench
benchmark.metric: episode return (undiscounted; random agent about 9, authors' target success score 800)
benchmark.human_reference: General adult population (typical able-bodied adults balancing on an unstable board, such as a wobble or rocker board with a fixed pivot)
